Bundled reader fonts

The four WOFF2 files are locally hosted subsets built from the public text in
dist/index.html. Rebuild them whenever a new chapter introduces new glyphs.

- long-night-songti.woff2: Noto Serif SC (Google Fonts)
  https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notoserifsc
- long-night-kaiti.woff2: LXGW WenKai v1.522
  https://github.com/lxgw/LxgwWenKai
- long-night-fangsong.woff2: Zhuque Fangsong v0.212
  https://github.com/TrionesType/zhuque
- long-night-heiti.woff2: Noto Sans SC (Google Fonts)
  https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanssc

All four source families are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Copies of the applicable licenses are included in the licenses directory.
